# foundry_model_version (Data Source)

Looks up a single version of a custom model registered on the project, for referencing an artifact this configuration does not own.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foundry_model_version" "classifier" {
  name    = "support-classifier"
  version = "1"
}

output "classifier_id" {
  value = data.foundry_model_version.classifier.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the model to look up.
- `version` (String) Version of the model to look up.

### Read-Only

- `base_model` (String) Asset ID of the base model this artifact adapts.
- `blob_uri` (String) URI of the model artifact in the storage the service issued for this version.
- `description` (String) Description recorded for the model version.
- `id` (String) Service-assigned model asset identifier.
- `tags` (Map of String) Key-value tags attached to the model version.
- `warnings` (List of String) Advisory warnings the service derived from inspecting the artifact.
- `weight_type` (String) How the artifact's weights are stored: `FullWeight`, `LoRA`, or `DraftModel`.
